generation_prompt: Scientific-educational visualization for a public sewer CCTV software demonstration. Original simulated photorealistic inspection frame of a fictional underground drain, wide 16:9. Frame the key feature toward center or mid-periphery so it is easy for a technical reader to locate. Single realistic still, coherent geometry. Camera looking straight down the center of a deformed ochre ribbed plastic drainage pipe, top wall buckled downward on the left, so the closest pipe cross section looks visibly pinched, broad and flattened while several downstream rings recover a round contour. Show the inward folds, neutral longitudinal camera angle and regular rings for perspective comparison. Dry invert with only a trace of silt. No jagged cracks, side outlet, logos, overlaid graphics or human figures.
